Duranta | Staff Backend Engineer | Full-Time | On-site | Seattle or NYC

We're building business-in-a-box software for landscaping companies, with mobile applications and an offline-capable web app. We're also doing custom AI (_not_ LLMs) to produce measurements from satellite imagery.

Our frontend is in React and React.Native, backend is in Go and Python. We're looking for someone who can lead the backend development and help us manage the data processing pipelines for AI training.

Job posting: https://jobs.lever.co/getduranta/50af551a-9a5c-498c-9729-6f2...

Contact: alex@getduranta.com (please put "HN" in the subject)
